source: Anonymous Chromium recording of the public ANCS /design-system page at http://127.0.0.1:4000; no account, user project, or database access.
reproduction: The script writes to an ignored .artifacts directory by default. Browser recording timing makes bytes and SHA-256 non-deterministic across runs; validate stream properties and decode for a new capture.
rights: The recorded UI is authored within the ANCS project; no third-party media or personal user data is visible.
brief: Actual browser screen capture of public design-system interactions: scroll, light/dark toggle, and a status-help dialog.
